messages:
Ava (People Ops): quick FYI: we have a short SOC2/attestation catch-up running this sprint for anyone who missed the spring window. Please complete the attestation form and upload any outstanding evidence by 05/15 EOD.

Ava (People Ops): If you already uploaded but the file name didnt match the convention, well ask you to rename. convention: team_controlid_shortdesc_YYYYMMDD.pdf. Put files in /Evidence/SOC2-Catchup/.

Jordan (Security): For monitoring artifacts, include a 1-paragraph README describing alert rules, owners, and retention. If exporting Kibana dashboards, zip the JSON export and add the README next to it. Example export command: 
```bash
# export dashboard snapshot
curl -u user:token "https://es.redwood.ai/api/kibana/dashboards/export?dashboard=all" -o dashboards-<date>.ndjson
```

Priya (Privacy): Small note: if an artifact contains customer PII, redact or provide a redaction rationale and include the signed redaction confirmation in the same folder. Reach out to legal@ if unsure.

ComplianceBot: Notice: 4 outstanding attestations across Eng + Sales. Deadline 05/15 23:59 UTC or a follow-up reminder will be triggered.

Ava (People Ops): Office hours this week: Wed 9:30-10:30 and Thu 16:00-17:00 in #help for filename checks and quick uploads. If you need a 48h extension for legal review, open an "evidence-ext" ticket and tag @Priya.

Jordan (Security): Heads-up: were doing a final audit import on 05/16 morning; late uploads after the deadline may not be reviewed until next cycle.

Ava (People Ops): Thanks all. TL;DR: attest + upload + rename if needed. Ping me or @Jordan/@Priya with blockers. :ok_hand:
